intro.message: Prosto z wypłaty, zanim cokolwiek zostanie wydane.
intro.context: Budget planner > Savings: explanation under the heading; savings are set aside first.

goal.context: Budget planner > Savings: small label under a savings goal's name.

onTime.context: Budget planner > Savings: chip that fills in what the goal needs per month to make its date. Lowercase, short.

onto.context: Budget planner > Savings: label before choosing which account a goal's money goes onto. Lowercase.

noAccount.message: Dodaj konto oszczędnościowe (karta Oszczędności), żeby móc to wpłacić.
noAccount.context: Budget planner > Savings: there's no account to pay into.

maxOut.context: Budget planner > Savings: chip that fills in what's left of an IKE/IKZE account's yearly limit. Lowercase, short.

paidInYear.context: Budget planner > Savings: an IKE/IKZE account's contributions this year against its yearly limit.

limitReached.context: Budget planner > Savings: the IKE/IKZE yearly limit is used up.

overLimit.message: {amount} ponad limit na {year}, instytucja tego nie przyjmie
overLimit.context: Budget planner > Savings: warning, the plan pays more into an IKE/IKZE than the yearly limit allows.

limitUnknown.message: Limit na {year} nie jest jeszcze znany; używam limitu na {known}.
limitUnknown.context: Budget planner > Savings: the IKE/IKZE limit for {year} isn't announced yet; the one for {known} is used.

owed.context: Budget planner > Savings: under a loan repayment, how much is still owed.

instalment.context: Budget planner > Savings: chip that fills in the loan's next instalment. Lowercase, short.

other.context: Budget planner > Savings: savings not tied to a goal or account.

otherHelp.context: Budget planner > Savings: explanation under 'Other savings'.

lineLabel.context: Budget planner > Savings: accessible label of the amount field of a goal, account or loan {name}.
